summary: Adds Rust project templates, and builds, runs, tests, and formats them on the device.
description: Bundles the Rust toolchain (rustc, cargo, rustfmt, rust-analyzer, and the clang linker) for 64-bit ARM, adds a starter crate and a std::net HTTP server template, highlights .rs files, and puts run, test, and format actions on the editor toolbar for Rust projects. Needs the 64-bit build of Code on the Go and about 600 MB of space.
